name: sillage-workflow
description: A human-governed, resumable engineering workflow for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Sillage keeps agent work small, decisions human-governed, state resumable, and completion claims backed by evidence. Its language-neutral engineering lenses cover architecture, testing, DDD, interfaces, systems, security, and platform boundaries without imposing a stack.
capabilities: Start a fresh conversation with a compact project state card
Shape, slice, build, prove, review, and hand off one vertical
Research with source authority and explicit evidence
Apply language-neutral architecture, testing, SOLID, DDD, interface, systems, security, platform, frontend, and data lenses
Recommend provider-neutral reasoning capability and effort per stage
Route bounded work to a parent or subagent with explicit isolation
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Sillage to keep this task bounded, human-governed, traceable, and evidence-backed.
